answer: Each agent identity is bound to an SGX enclave with TPM-rooted keys; a zero-knowledge attestation circuit validates enclave code and a VDF orders registrations. The karst state tree commits accepted identities, knoll is its hash anchor, and bridge is the consensus contract that verifies proofs. Forging requires compromising hardware or sustained VDF computation; identities follow an O(N^2) bonding curve, with collateral irreversibly slashed on equivocation.
